Title: Missing Server-Side CSRF Validation on State-Changing API Endpoints with SameSite=None Session Cookies
Reproduction: 1. Log in to obtain valid access_token cookie. 2. Send POST request to /api/v1/cases with valid cookie but omitting X-CSRF-Token header. 3. Send POST request to /api/v1/cases with valid cookie and invalid fake X-CSRF-Token header.
Expected: The backend server must reject state-changing requests missing or having invalid CSRF tokens with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
Actual: State-changing POST request succeeds with HTTP 200 OK and persists case in database regardless of CSRF header value. Combined with SameSite=None cookie, enables Cross-Site Request Forgery.
Evidence: docs/audit/live-vercel-evidence/security_audit_results.json line 26-27: Status 200 on missing and fake CSRF token tests
RootCause: FastAPI backend lacks middleware or dependency checking the X-CSRF-Token header against the session cookie or HMAC signature. Additionally, Set-Cookie configures SameSite=None instead of SameSite=Lax.
Fix: Implement an enforce_csrf FastAPI dependency on all state-changing endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH) comparing X-CSRF-Token against a cryptographically signed cookie token. Change session cookie attribute to SameSite=Lax.
AcceptanceCriteria: POST requests without valid matching X-CSRF-Token return HTTP 403 Forbidden. Legitimate requests from frontend continue to succeed.
ExistingTestCoverage: None (Unit tests did not test cross-site cookie forgery)

Title: Document Upload Endpoint Crashes with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error in Production
Reproduction: 1. Log in as an authenticated user. 2. Submit multipart/form-data upload of a valid PDF document to /api/v1/documents/upload. 3. Observe response.
Expected: The document should be uploaded to secure storage and its metadata persisted with HTTP 200 OK.
Actual: The endpoint throws an unhandled server exception and returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with code INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.
Evidence: docs/audit/live-vercel-evidence/test_authenticated_doc_upload.py output: Upload HTTPError Status 500 with request_id e0be5ddd-efa8-4de0-9f01-137c99484101
RootCause: The backend storage adapter is unconfigured or attempting to write to a read-only directory in the serverless environment instead of Supabase Storage bucket / S3 / /tmp.
Fix: Configure valid cloud storage provider credentials (Supabase Storage / AWS S3) in backend environment variables and ensure the upload handler streams to cloud storage rather than local disk.
AcceptanceCriteria: Authenticated upload of valid PDF returns HTTP 200 with document ID and persistence verified.
ExistingTestCoverage: Mock/unit test only (local tests used mock storage)

Title: Simulated Inference (MockLLM) Used in Live Production Multi-Agent Assistant
Reproduction: 1. Navigate to /agents or send POST to /api/v1/agents/chat with query "Which government portal should I use to check land ownership records in Maharashtra?" and jurisdiction "IN". 2. Observe agent execution.
Expected: Multi-agent system should invoke real LLM provider (Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic) to decompose query and execute agent reasoning with tool calls.
Actual: Agent returns hardcoded mock string "[MockLLM Response grounded on evidence]: Understanding verified for query." with steps_executed=1 and tool_calls=[]. No real inference occurs.
Evidence: docs/audit/live-vercel-evidence/agents_answered_1793177371998.png and live backend probe returning "[MockLLM Response grounded on evidence]"
RootCause: Backend agent runner defaults to MockLLM provider because LLM provider API keys and model configurations are unset or toggled to mock mode.
Fix: Configure active production LLM provider (e.g. Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash) with API keys in Vercel backend environment variables and toggle LLM_PROVIDER from mock to gemini/openai.
AcceptanceCriteria: Agent chat returns dynamic evidence-grounded responses executing tool calls against the knowledge base.

Title: Missing Gemini API Key in Production Intelligent Document Processing Pipeline
Reproduction: 1. Authenticate with valid session. 2. Submit valid PDF to /api/v1/document-processing/process. 3. Inspect parsed document evidence JSON.
Expected: Real Gemini AI extracts document structure metadata and classification without fallback warnings.
Actual: Backend returns simulated "Mock Document" with "Mock Authority" and explicitly includes "API Key Missing" in risk_flags array.
RootCause: GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable is not defined or is empty in the production Vercel environment.
Fix: Supply valid GEMINI_API_KEY in Vercel backend settings and restart service. Ensure fallback mode logs a warning and does not masquerade as successful real classification.
AcceptanceCriteria: Document processing extracts authentic text entities and classifications without "API Key Missing" flag.
ExistingTestCoverage: None (offline tests ran with mock classification)

Title: Hallucinated and Forced Statutory Citations on Fictional and Non-Indian Legal Queries
Reproduction: 1. Post query "Under Section 42 of the Indian Space Exploration and Asteroid Mining Act of 2021 what are the licensing requirements?" to /api/v1/legal/query. 2. Post query "How do I apply for a US Green Card under H1B visa regulations?". 3. Observe citations and confidence.
Expected: The engine should detect unsupported statutes or out-of-jurisdiction queries and trigger a circuit breaker with 0.0 confidence and an explicit insufficiency warning.
Actual: Engine returns 0.98 confidence citing RTI Act Section 19 and Consumer Protection Act Section 47 for fictional asteroid mining act. For US Green Card it returns 0.95 confidence citing RTI Act Section 19.
RootCause: Vector search calculates nearest neighbor across a tiny 12-record index without a minimum cosine similarity threshold cutoff (e.g. 0.72) and lacks an intent/jurisdiction classification gate.
Fix: Introduce a strict vector distance threshold cutoff (e.g. cosine distance < 0.28 / similarity > 0.72) before mapping evidence. If no chunk meets threshold return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE state with confidence 0.0.
AcceptanceCriteria: Queries regarding non-Indian law or non-existent statutes return confidence 0.0 and explicit disclaimer stating no statutory evidence was found in the indexed corpus.
ExistingTestCoverage: None (test corpus only queried matching topics)

Title: Government Services Database Table Is Empty in Production
Reproduction: 1. Navigate to /government in browser or send GET request to /api/v1/government/services. 2. Observe scheme cards and count.
Expected: Database should serve indexed central and state government schemes (e.g. PM-KISAN Ayushman Bharat etc.).
Actual: Endpoint returns empty data array [] and live page renders "Verified Schemes (0)". Problem analyzer cannot match any schemes.
RootCause: Production PostgreSQL database migration ran table schemas but the seed script for government services was never executed.
Fix: Execute the database seed script to populate official Central and State government schemes with eligibility criteria official portal URLs and category tags.
AcceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/government/services returns indexed schemes. Live /government page displays searchable scheme cards.
ExistingTestCoverage: Unit tests used local sqlite fixture

Title: Frontend Graph Neighborhood Explorer Calls Non-Existent Backend Endpoint Resulting in HTTP 404
Reproduction: 1. On /knowledge search for a topic. 2. Click "Explore Graph Neighborhood" on an entity result. 3. Inspect browser network console.
Expected: The graph explorer should request the entity relationships from the backend and visualize neighboring nodes and edges.
Actual: The frontend calls GET /api/v1/knowledge/graph/neighborhood/{entity_id}?max_depth=2 which does not exist on the backend returning HTTP 404 Not Found.
Evidence: docs/audit/live-vercel-evidence/chunks/2nx14pf-l64qn.js line 32073 and curl probe returning 404 {"detail": "Not Found"}
RootCause: Endpoint naming mismatch: Frontend expects /api/v1/knowledge/graph/neighborhood/{id} while backend implements /api/v1/knowledge/entities/{entity_id}/relationships and /api/v1/knowledge/graph/query.
Fix: Either implement an alias route /api/v1/knowledge/graph/neighborhood/{entity_id} on the backend or update the frontend API client to call /api/v1/knowledge/entities/{entity_id}/relationships.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Explore Graph Neighborhood" successfully renders graph nodes and edges without HTTP 404.
ExistingTestCoverage: None (Frontend and backend tested in isolation)

Title: Silent Error Swallowing on Unauthenticated Access to Protected Routes (/cases /documents /admin)
Reproduction: 1. In a fresh incognito browser window navigate to /cases or /documents. 2. Observe rendered page and developer console.
Expected: Unauthenticated users should be redirected to /auth/login with a return URL or presented with a clear "Sign In Required" card.
Actual: Page renders an empty workspace with non-functional controls. The 401 Unauthorized API error is swallowed via console.error leaving user stranded with no feedback.
RootCause: Frontend components lack authentication boundary guards (e.g. useAuth hook or Next.js middleware) and swallow rejected promises in .catch(e => console.error(e)).
Fix: Implement an AuthGuard component or Next.js route middleware redirecting unauthenticated users to /auth/login?redirect={path} and display actionable error toasts on API failures.
AcceptanceCriteria: Visiting /cases while unauthenticated immediately redirects to /auth/login with an informative banner.

Title: Broken Statutory Sources Navigation Link in Global Footer Leads to Next.js 404 Page
Reproduction: 1. Scroll to the footer on any page. 2. Click on "Statutory Sources Registry" link pointing to /legal/acts. 3. Observe destination.
Expected: Navigation should open the statutory acts catalog or sources registry.
Actual: Browser renders Next.js 404 "This page could not be found".
RootCause: The Next.js app directory lacks a /legal/acts/page.tsx route. The feature is located at /admin/sources or only exists as backend API /api/v1/legal/acts.
Fix: Either create the public route app/legal/acts/page.tsx displaying indexed Acts or update footer hyperlink to point to /admin/sources or /legal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Statutory Sources Registry" in footer successfully navigates to an active verified page.

Title: Empty Query Submission to Legal Engine Returns HTTP 200 with Canned RTI Citations
Reproduction: 1. Send POST request to /api/v1/legal/query with body {"query": "", "jurisdiction": "IN"}. 2. Observe response.
Expected: The API should validate inputs and return HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity requiring query length >= 3.
Actual: API returns HTTP 200 OK with confidence 0.98 and automatically assigns citations for RTI Act 2005.
RootCause: FastAPI Pydantic schema for LegalQueryRequest defines query as an unconstrained string without min_length=3 validation.
Fix: Add Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=1000) to the query attribute in LegalQueryRequest schema.
AcceptanceCriteria: Sending empty or whitespace query returns HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with clear validation message.

Title: Missing Standard Security Headers Across Frontend and Backend Services
Reproduction: 1. Send HEAD/GET requests to https://civicsphere-web.vercel.app and https://civicsphere-backend.vercel.app. 2. Inspect response headers.
Expected: Modern HTTP security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) should be set on all responses.
Actual: All security headers except Strict-Transport-Security are missing on both frontend and backend responses.
RootCause: Vercel deployment configurations (vercel.json, next.config.js) and FastAPI CORSMiddleware lack custom security header rules.
Fix: Configure security headers in next.config.js for frontend and add SecurityHeadersMiddleware in FastAPI backend.
AcceptanceCriteria: Security headers test confirms presence of CSP, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy.

Title: Navbar Navigation Overflows Horizontally on Mobile Viewports (<400px) Lacking Hamburger Drawer
Reproduction: 1. Resize browser to 375px width. 2. Inspect top navigation bar. 3. Observe header elements.
Expected: Navigation links should collapse into an accessible hamburger menu drawer.
Actual: Nav links scroll horizontally across top bar crowding out action buttons and theme toggle without a drawer button.
RootCause: The navigation component uses a single flex row with overflow-x-auto on mobile rather than implementing a responsive mobile drawer dialog.
Fix: Add a responsive hamburger menu component for viewports below sm breakpoint (640px) with slide-over drawer.
AcceptanceCriteria: Top bar remains clean on mobile viewports (320px-640px) with full navigation accessible via hamburger icon.

Title: Legal Guidance Procedural Action Steps Field Is Consistently Empty Across Queries
Reproduction: 1. Submit any legal query (RTI, Consumer Protection, DPDP) to /api/v1/legal/query. 2. Inspect how_it_may_help_or_steps field in response data.
Expected: The guidance engine should provide actionable procedural next steps for citizens based on statutory rules.
Actual: The how_it_may_help_or_steps field is consistently an empty string "" across all tested queries.
RootCause: The backend response formatter does not map procedural steps from retrieval chunks or LLM output into the response object.
Fix: Update the retrieval pipeline and LLM prompt to synthesize concrete procedural steps and map them into the how_it_may_help_or_steps field.
AcceptanceCriteria: Legal query responses return a populated numbered list of actionable procedural steps.

Title: Government Problem Analysis Flags Provided Annual Income as Missing Parameter
Reproduction: 1. Send POST request to /api/v1/government/analyze with citizen_context: {"annual_income": 100000, "category": "General"}. 2. Inspect missing_parameters array.
Expected: The analyzer should recognize that annual_income is provided and exclude it from missing_parameters.
Actual: The response lists annual_income under extracted_parameters but simultaneously includes it under missing_parameters.
RootCause: The parameter validation check in the analyze service tests against a different dictionary key or does not check citizen_context correctly.
Fix: Align the key check in problem analyzer so that parameters supplied in citizen_context are omitted from missing_parameters.
AcceptanceCriteria: Supplying annual_income in citizen_context ensures it does not appear in missing_parameters.

Title: Public Exposure of Administrative Dashboard Shell to Unauthenticated Visitors
Reproduction: 1. Navigate directly to https://civicsphere-web.vercel.app/admin in browser. 2. Observe rendered page.
Expected: Administrative pages should strictly redirect unauthenticated visitors to login or show access denied.
Actual: The frontend shell renders the full Admin Control Center layout with metric cards and tables before backend 403 occurs.
RootCause: Client-side admin route lacks an AdminGuard checking user session and role === "ADMIN" prior to rendering.
Fix: Add AdminRouteGuard to /admin layout redirecting non-admin users to homepage with an access denied toast.
AcceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated visitors navigating to /admin are redirected to /auth/login.

Title: Minimal Production Knowledge Corpus Limited to 3 Statutes and 12 Vector Embeddings
Expected: Production system should index comprehensive statutory acts and government schemes across Indian civic domains.
Actual: Readiness telemetry reveals corpus contains only 34 graph nodes and 12 vector records covering only 3 acts.
RootCause: The knowledge ingestion pipeline was only executed on initial sample fixtures during development.
Fix: Run the full statutory ingestion pipeline to ingest the complete set of targeted Indian central acts, rules, and gazette notifications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Readiness telemetry shows comprehensive entity and vector coverage across targeted civic domains.

Title: Missing robots.txt and sitemap.xml Static Route Handlers
Expected: Server should return valid robots.txt and sitemap.xml to guide search crawlers and prevent indexing of administrative paths.
RootCause: No robots.ts or sitemap.ts route handlers are defined in the Next.js app directory.
Fix: Add app/robots.ts and app/sitemap.ts defining crawler directives and public route index.
AcceptanceCriteria: Visiting /robots.txt returns valid text/plain directives and /sitemap.xml returns valid XML sitemap.
